title: What is Passlet?
description: Give coding agents scoped GitHub access with approval on your Mac.
seoTitle: Scoped GitHub access for your coding agents
seoDescription: Give coding agents short-lived GitHub access with approval on your Mac. Learn how Passlet scopes permissions and keeps GitHub credentials under your control.

title: How Passlet works
description: Understand Agents, Approver, and how scoped credentials reach your coding tools.
seoTitle: How Agents request scoped GitHub credentials
seoDescription: Learn how Passlet Agents request scoped GitHub credentials from Approver on your Mac, how you approve access, and what happens when your Mac goes offline.

title: Quick start
description: Install Passlet, connect GitHub, and approve your first request.
seoTitle: Quick start: approve your first GitHub request
seoDescription: Install Passlet, connect your GitHub account, and add it to Claude Code or Codex. Approve your first scoped request on your Mac, then connect a remote Agent.

title: Installation
description: Install Approver on macOS and Agent on macOS or Linux using Homebrew or Nix.
seoTitle: Install Approver and Agent with Homebrew or Nix
seoDescription: Install Passlet Approver on macOS and Agent on macOS or Linux using Homebrew or Nix. Configure startup, connect your Agents, and learn to update or uninstall.

title: FAQ
seoTitle: FAQ: grant caching, Keychain and scheduled tasks
seoDescription: Learn how Passlet protects GitHub credentials, reuses grants across sessions, avoids caching when needed, and handles access for unattended scheduled tasks.

title: Setup and troubleshooting
description: Set up GitHub, pair Agents, configure SSH or Tailscale, and diagnose connection problems.
seoTitle: GitHub setup, Agent pairing and troubleshooting
seoDescription: Set up GitHub, pair Passlet Agents, and connect through SSH or Tailscale. Diagnose connection problems, configure repository groups, and forward your SSH agent.

title: Contributing
description: Contribution licensing and acknowledgment for pull requests.
seoTitle: Contributing code and documentation to Passlet
seoDescription: Learn the MIT licensing terms for contributing to Passlet, confirm your right to submit changes, and complete the contribution acknowledgment on a pull request.

title: Writing documentation
description: Write Markdown docs with OS tabs, diagrams, expandable details, and release labels.
seoTitle: Writing guides and documentation for Passlet
seoDescription: Write and preview Passlet docs using Markdown, OS tabs, diagrams, callouts, and release labels. Learn how the website imports guides from its repository.
